title: BYO corpus record — confluence
description: A Confluence page or blogpost. Title -> title, content -> body.storage. `container` is the space. Use `parent` for child pages.

content.description: The retrieval payload served verbatim as the body.

title.description: Document title (email subject / file name / issue title / page title).

content_id.description: The id `/wiki/rest/api/content/{id}` serves this page under, as the corpus writes it. Stored and served verbatim. An omitted id is synthesized from the doc_id and assigned at import, probed so it stays unique. Provide one when APPENDING to a corpus that already has confluence pages: without it a re-imported page cannot be told apart from a new one.

space.description: The space this document belongs to.

group.description: ACL group owning the space (default: slug(container)); null means the container owns no group, so nothing is group-scoped to it.

author_name.description: The owner's display name as the corpus writes it, served as the document's owner (a name is not recoverable from an email address).

visibility.description: public = org-wide, group = the container's group, private = author only.

readers.description: Explicit reader principals. `user:<email>` / `group:<id>` / `org:<name>` state the type; unprefixed, an address is a user and anything else a group. Overrides visibility — and an EMPTY array means nobody may read the document (admin-only), not everybody.

updated.description: version.when / last-modified (epoch seconds or ISO 8601). Default: created + 1h.

version_number.description: version.number. Default: 2 if updated != created, else 1.

items.description: A comment on the document (served via the vendor's comment API).

created_ts.description: Optional creation time (epoch seconds or ISO string).
